html: Kitsumkalum is one of the fourteen tribes of the Tsimshian nation in British Columbia, Canada. Its main reserve lies just west of Terrace, where the Kitsumkalum River flows into the Skeena. Its territories (laxyuup) ran from the Kitsumkalum valley down the Skeena toward the coast, around Lakelse Lake and the Zymagotitz River, and archaeology shows long settlement in the valley. Like other Tsimshian, they are organised in house groups whose chiefs hold names, crests and land through the mother's line. Their neighbours up the river are the Kitselas, and farther inland the Gitxsan.
